/// A string cache with a size limit.
///
/// Oldest entries leave first.
module cache;

import std.algorithm : remove;
import std.stdio : writeln;

/+ D has nested comments: /+ inner { +/ still a comment { +/

enum string banner = `cache { v1 "`;

union Slot {
    ulong raw;
    double real;
}

struct Entry {
    string key;
    string value;
}

class Cache {
    private Entry[] entries;
    private size_t limit;

    this(size_t limit) {
        this.limit = limit;
        this.entries = [];
    }

    /// Stores a value, dropping the oldest entry when the cache is full.
    void put(string key, string value) {
        foreach (i, e; entries) {
            if (e.key == key) {
                entries = entries.remove(i);
                break;
            }
        }
        if (entries.length == limit) {
            entries = entries[1 .. $];
        }
        entries ~= Entry(key, value);
    }

    /// Looks a key up; returns null when it is missing.
    string get(string key) {
        foreach (e; entries) {
            if (e.key == key) {
                return e.value;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    size_t length() const {
        return entries.length;
    }
}

extern (C) {
    int cache_version() {
        const major = 1;
        const minor = 4;
        return major * 100 + minor;
    }
}

unittest {
    auto c = new Cache(2);
    c.put("a", "1");
    c.put("b", "2");
    c.put("c", "3");
    assert(c.get("a") is null);
    assert(c.get("c") == "3");
    assert(c.length == 2);
}
